source_platform_context: JJ Kane is a true no-reserve absolute auction run on the Proxibid platform. Every lot sells to the highest bidder regardless of price -- there is no hidden reserve. Archived Proxibid catalogs publicly show 'Sold for: USD X' hammer prices for closed lots, with winning bidder aliases partially masked; live catalogs show current high bid per lot, also without login. Regional sales run roughly every two weeks per region (Northeast, Western/Gov, Southeast, Central). Buyer's fee is approximately 12% (verify per ring), plus a $125 flat admin fee on titled items and a 2.95% credit card surcharge. Same national fleet consignors (e.g. AT&T via Banc of America Leasing, utilities, government agencies) recur every cycle, so the supply of comparable fleet vans refreshes regularly.
